HTTPBearer.description: Dev mode: the dev token (API_DEV_TOKEN) plus X-Tenant-Id and X-User-Id. Token mode (API_TOKENS set): one of the configured tokens; the X-* headers are ignored.

info.description:
The front half of an AI mobile-app builder: talk to it, approve a plain-language Brief (Gate 1),
let it research and write one `APP_SPEC.md`, approve the Plan (Gate 2), and receive `spec_ready`.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. In dev mode (local use only, never on a network)
the token is `API_DEV_TOKEN` and the caller declares itself with `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-User-Id` and
`X-Roles`; when the server has `API_TOKENS` the token itself selects the identity and those headers
are ignored. Every failure is `{"code", "message"}`.
info.title: Context Engine API

get.description: The process is up. Touches nothing else.

Ready when the database answers a trivial query and the budget ledger is sound.

No authentication, so only "ok" or a one-word failure per check: never a reason, a path, a
number or the budget's state (the spend and the tripwire are `GET /v1/budget`, which is
authenticated).

Totals of the LLM gateway's budget (mock mode: zero). For development.

Totals only: no per-scope breakdown (it would list other tenants' session ids and spend) and no
tripwire. The gateway's own `/v1/budget` is service to service and unchanged.

post.description: Starts an app conversation in DISCOVERING and returns the session plus the greeting events (a canned message with starter chips; no LLM call). Rate limited per caller and per tenant (`429` with `Retry-After`). A tenant bound to a set of policies (`TENANT_POLICIES`, or the caller's token entry) can only start those: anything else is `403`. An Enterprise session starts from the tenant's Org Profile: the one posted in `org_profile` (stored first, replacing the old one) or else the stored one; Discover turns it into assumed slots. A Guided session never reads it.

post.description:
One of `user_message`, `option_selected`, `upload_added`, `gate_decision`, `ui_action`.

Idempotent by `event_id`: a repeat returns the original replies and has no second effect.
Discover turns answer synchronously. Approving Gate 1 enqueues the plan job (research, build);
the response is then `202` and the job's progress arrives on the stream.
